description: This file is a configuration/setup module for Vitest testing framework, defining functions to load patterns from environment variables and create scoped Vitest configs specific to 'extension-acpx'. It also exports a default configuration for the extension.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns for tests from environment variables, defaulting to process.env.

methods.name: export function createExtensionAcpxVitestConfig( createExtensionAcpxVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for the 'extension-acpx', incorporating include patterns and setup files.
